title: Great Falls Tribune reports of strange lights that week

tellings.quote: Because we had actually had um newspaper accounts in the Great Falls Tribune

plain: In the same week in 1967 that UFOs were reportedly seen near nuclear missile sites in Montana, the Great Falls Tribune newspaper carried accounts of strange lights in the sky. That is what Robert Salas, a former Air Force officer who says he was on duty at one of those sites, tells Michels. To Salas, the reports mean people outside the base saw something too.
